title: add-benchmark-lab-profiling-baselines-and-reporting-pipeline-v114
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: Add the next iteration of benchmarking and reporting infrastructure to support multi-variant profiling baselines and representative workload runners used by the benchmark lab. This change wires new runners into the reporting pipeline, improves telemetry tags for model/config-level aggregation, and adds baseline artifacts for adaptive-batching experiments (v114).

What this PR does: checklist: - Add representative workload runners for streaming chat, long-form summarization, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). - Add profiling baseline JSON artifacts for quantized 7B/13B/70B variants (stored under benchmark-data/profiling/v114/*). - Update the reporting pipeline (etl/reporting/pipelines/benchmark_ingest) to accept runner metadata and per-run environment tags (hw_type, quant, schedule_policy). - Add Prometheus/metrics tags and tracing spans for runner start/end and KV-cache hit-rate. - Add unit and integration tests for the new ingest schema and the runner shims. - Add docs and dashboard links in redwood-docs for v114 baselines.

Implementation notes: The runner code is added as shims under benchmark-lab/runners/{rag,chat,summarize}_runner.py that reuse the existing runner framework but emit the new telemetry envelope (benchmark_run_v2). The reporting pipeline uses a new Avro schema (bench.v2.ingest) and a lightweight transformation that normalizes model variant identifiers so that quantized/float variants map to the same canonical model name for rollups. Migration: ingest accepts both v1 and v2 envelopes for backward compatibility; downstream dashboards will be switched to v2 after a week of parallel ingestion.

Files changed summary (high level): - benchmark-lab/runners/*: new representative workload runners and small helper modules - benchmark-data/profiling/v114/*: baseline JSON artifacts and metadata - etl/reporting/pipelines/benchmark_ingest.py: add v2 envelope parsing and normalization - telemetry/metrics/registry.py: add tagged metrics for kv_cache_hit_rate and runner_latency_p50/p95 - tests/: integration tests for ingest + runner smoke tests - docs/benchmark-lab/v114.md: migration notes and dashboard links

Backwards compatibility: The pipeline accepts legacy v1 envelopes and will route them to the v1 transformer. v2 envelopes add hw_type and quant fields used only for improved rollups; these are optional.

Performance expectations: This change does not change serving runtime performance. The profiling baselines include measured medians for the recorded workloads; numbers are included in benchmark-data/profiling/v114/README but are not asserted in CI (used for dashboards and regression detection).

Deployment plan: Merge to main, enable parallel ingestion in staging for 48 hours, flip dashboards to v2 after successful runs, then deprecate v1 ingestion after two weeks.

Related: ENG-1472, ENG-1499, SUP-8841.
